notes: Specific Scheduler business codes are preserved across the gateway.
Upstream service credentials are not caller credentials; their rejection remains HTTP 503 at the inference edge.
Legacy error.message, model-management detail, and Messages type=error are preserved.
Successful legacy payloads and upstream inference streams remain unchanged.

business_codes.WAIT_MEMORY_HEADROOM: Insufficient observed available RAM after safety reserve and outstanding commitments. Unload idle models or explicitly select a lower-memory execution configuration.
business_codes.WAIT_STOP_CONFIRMATION: Prior native computation has not yet supplied a valid stop receipt; the inference gateway retries rejected admission for up to eight seconds without sending a provider request.
